title: Extended column projection differential on horizontal tail generators
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category admitting total complexes of natural-indexed first-quadrant bicomplexes. Let $K$ be such a bicomplex, $p,h\in\mathbb N$ with $p\le h$, and $m,i,j\in\mathbb Z$ with $m-p=i$ and $m+1-p=j$. Let $s_{K,h,m}$ be coneHorizontalSummand [lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable]. Let $P_m$ and $P_{m+1}$ be horizontalExtendedProjection [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection], followed by the canonical identifications of their column target degrees with $i$ and $j$, respectively. Then $s_{K,h,m}\,d_{\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(K))}^{m,m+1}\,P_{m+1}=(-1)^p\,s_{K,h,m}\,P_m\,d_{\operatorname{extend}(K^{p,\bullet})}^{i,j}$, with composition read left to right.

proof.text: For a valid natural total summand expand total_d, ι_D₁ and ι_D₂, followed by d₁_eq' and d₂_eq'. Projection kills the horizontal term because h+1>p. If h>p it kills the vertical term too. If h=p, the canonical degree identifications reduce the vertical coefficient to (-1)^p. An invalid summand inclusion is zero by ιTotalOrZero_eq_zero.

proof.text: For nonnegative integer degree and h≤m.toNat, use extend_d_eq and the definition of the extended projections to conjugate the preceding equality. The assumptions imply p≤m. The inverse extension isomorphism composed with a degree-equality isomorphism is the corresponding inverse extension isomorphism in the new degree. For h>m.toNat the total summand is zero; for m<0 the extended summand is zero by definition.
